papers.title: Visual Distortion Detection in UGC Images Using Large Multimodal Models
papers.authors: Ziheng Jia, Yingji Liang, Jiaying Qian, Xiongkuo Min
papers.affiliations: 1Shanghai Jiao Tong University, 2East China Normal University
papers.intro: 提出VIGIL，一个基于LMM架构的局部失真检测模型，通过构建大规模合成失真训练集VIGIL-140K、利用LLM多层作为同步检测器，并保留背景类预测中的失真线索，显著提升了域内合成失真检测和S2A泛化能力。

papers.title: Guardian Crawler: Retrieval-First Knowledge Discovery with Bounded LLM Augmentation for Noisy Web Intelligence
papers.authors: Joshua Castillo, Santosh Nukavarapu, Ravi Mukkamala
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, Old Dominion University
papers.intro: Guardian Crawler 提出了一个基于合成 mini-web 的可复现、模块化检索优先测试平台，结合 BM25 检索与风险感知、嵌入增强和混合重排序，并通过受限的 RAG 生成带引用的摘要，从而在噪声网络智能任务中实现可控的、有证据依据的知识发现。

papers.title: Integrated Multimodal AI System for Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning, Object Sensing, and Damage Analysis
papers.authors: Kalelo Dukuray, Israel Pina, Evan Perez, Erika Ardiles-Cruz, Jie Wei
papers.affiliations: City College of New York（Dept. of Computer Science）；Air Force Research Lab（Rome, NY）
papers.intro: 论文提出并验证了一个集成了向量与知识图谱RAG、红外/可见光融合目标检测与分割、以及无线信号感知的统一多模态AI系统，用于在复杂与极端条件下实现更鲁棒、可解释和准确的损伤评估。

papers.title: A Dynamic-Semantics Framework for Grounding Human Referring Expressions in Visual Perceptual Data
papers.authors: Joseph Bingham
papers.tags: visual grounding, image retrieval, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: Department of Biology, Technion University, Haifa, IL（以色列）
papers.intro: 论文提出一个将词汇趋同中的“约定状态”外部化为Γ、Ξ、Ω三个显式集合的动态语义框架，并通过SIFT单应变换和UQI相似度把人类指称表达与抽象tangram图像进行感知对齐，在Stanford重复参考游戏语料上实现了单次话语下83.56%的top-5识别准确率。

papers.title: Your VLM Already Knows When: Training-Free Temporal Grounding by Asking Yes or No
papers.authors: Ji Huang, Barry Devereux, Hui Wang
papers.affiliations: Queen's University Belfast
papers.intro: 论文证明VLM时间定位失败的根本原因在任务接口（直接回归时间戳）而非感知能力，并提出免训练的FV-Action方法，通过冻结VLM回答二元“是与否”问题并进行粗细扫描，显著提升时间定位性能。

papers.title: Search over the Visual World: Persistent Visual Memory, Layered Indexes, and Source-Grounded Evidence
papers.authors: Sankalp Nagaonkar, Rohit Garg, Ankit Raj, Ashish Choithani, Ashutosh Trivedi
papers.affiliations: VideoDB
papers.intro: 论文提出了一种搜索视觉世界的概念与形式化模型——通过持久视觉记忆、分层索引和源接地证据，并以VideoDB数据格式（VDB）作为生产级参考实现，证明在视觉检索中系统设计比视频专属预训练更能决定最终检索质量。

papers.title: Vision-Language Grounding as Bidirectional Concept Correspondence
papers.authors: Jieyu Zhang, Ziqi Gao, Luke Zettlemoyer, Ranjay Krishna
papers.tags: visual grounding, semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, object detection
papers.affiliations: University of Washington; Allen Institute for AI; FAIR at Meta
papers.intro: 论文将视觉语言接地重新定义为图像-文本对之间的双向概念对应，并提出ConCor-1模型，利用可学习桥接标记联合预测文本掩码、图像掩码和对应存在性，在长描述和零样本大词汇量接地任务上显著优于现有基线。

papers.title: Keep It Simple: Multi-Key Episodic Memory Retrieval for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Yeeun Choi, Youngbeom Yoo, Joon-Young Lee, Hyolim Kang, Seon Joo Kim
papers.affiliations: Yonsei University; Adobe Research
papers.intro: MERIT提出一种极简的“多键情节记忆+推理时邻居过滤”框架，在记忆构建阶段仅保留高召回率的轻量索引，将高层语义组合推迟到查询时，从而在超长视频问答上实现高效且最优的性能。

papers.title: SABRE: Scalable and Automated Benchmarking of VLMs under Stress
papers.authors: Zixuan Lan, Luzhe Sun, Matthew R. Walter, Jiawei Zhou
papers.affiliations: University of Chicago; Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago; Stony Brook University
papers.intro: 本文提出SABRE——一个可扩展、自动化的VLM压力测试构建流水线，能够将用户用Markdown写的任务设计（Test Primer）自动转化为结构化的样本规范、生成或编辑的图像以及问答对，并通过自动过滤和人工审核生成高质量、可持续更新的压力测试基准。

papers.title: Conformal Coverage Guarantees for Any Video Temporal Grounder
papers.authors: Aseel Mohamed, Rasul Khanbayov, Erchin Serpedin, Hasan Kurban
papers.affiliations: Texas A&M University at Qatar; Hamad Bin Khalifa University; Texas A&M University
papers.intro: Cover是一种模型无关的后处理包装器，通过在校准集上对时间非一致性分数进行分位数校准并扩展基础预测，使任何视频时序定位器（训练好的局部器或黑盒视频-语言模型）输出的时间区域以至少1−α的概率包含真实时刻，且无需重训练或白盒访问。

papers.title: I Seek You in Videos: Identity-Conditioned Queries for Person-Centric Video Reasoning
papers.authors: Shibo Gao, Chongxiao Wang, Chenglong Huang, Jie Ma, Haolin Shi, Fei Ding, Jing Li, Qiang Lyu, Yangyang Liu, Yang Liu, Jun Liu, Linlin Huang, Peipei Yang
papers.affiliations: 北京交通大学；虎鲸数字媒体与娱乐集团；中国科学院自动化研究所；中国科学院大学；同济大学；兰卡斯特大学
papers.intro: 论文提出Identity-conditioned Queries（ICQ）任务，并构建了包含基准、训练集和训练框架的ISYV系统，以推动人物中心视频推理的研究，同时揭示了现有MLLM在身份匹配和长期跟踪上的瓶颈。

papers.title: UniJEPA: A Unified Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Task-Agnostic Visual World Modeling
papers.authors: An Lanji, Dawei Liu, Jin Li, Haoran Xu, Mei Chen, Yu Tian
papers.affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Chengdu, China
papers.intro: UniJEPA提出一种统一的联合嵌入预测架构，在共享潜在空间中同时学习光度预测（图像级变换）和时间预测（视频级动态），使用单一高斯正则化器实现可证明的防坍塌，并支持可控抽象和零样本规划。

papers.title: LitTraceQA: A Benchmark for Multi-Stage Grounding and Verification in Scientific Question Answering
papers.authors: Xuye Liu, Yimu Wang, Peng Shi, Bo Xue, Xiangrui Ke, Songcheng Cai, Kath Choi, Di Wu, Freda Shi, Krzysztof Czarnecki
papers.affiliations: University of Waterloo, Amazon, City University of Hong Kong, University of Amsterdam
papers.intro: LitTraceQA 是一个科学文献问答基准，要求系统同时输出相关论文标识、类型化证据位置和最终答案，以显式评估从论文检索到证据定位再到答案生成的完整可验证链路。

papers.title: H2AL: Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Aggregative Learning for Registration-based Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Jia Wang, Jiaming Cai, Zunying Hu, Zhanjie Wu, Jinyuan Liu, Hua Cheng, Yun Peng
papers.affiliations: Dalian University of Technology; Beijing Children’s Hospital, Capital Medical University; Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications
papers.intro: H2AL提出一个双曲层次感知聚合学习框架，通过向欧氏空间注入双曲层次先验，并采用梯度聚合联合优化配准与分割，从而提升配准伪标签质量和少样本医学图像分割性能，尤其针对小解剖结构。

papers.title: Same Attention, Different Truths: Put Logit-Lens over Visual Attention to Detect and Mitigate LVLM Object Hallucination
papers.authors: Zichuan Wang, Songlin Yang, Bo Peng, Zhenchen Tang, Yang Li, Beibei Dong, Jing Dong
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image captioning, visual grounding, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; New Laboratory of Pattern Recognition, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Science; Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
papers.intro: 本文通过Logit Lens解码视觉注意力区域中的语义内容，发现真实与幻觉对象在注意力强度上无显著差异但在语义解码上存在一致性差异，据此将对象幻觉划分为视觉不确定性和上下文先验两类，并提出一种无需训练的"检测-缓解"框架，在多个幻觉基准上取得最优性能。

papers.title: Gaze Behavior in Visual World Experiments Can be Modeled With Off-the-shelf Language-Vision Encoders
papers.authors: Rahul Murali Shankar, Titus von der Malsburg, Sebastian Padó
papers.affiliations: University of Stuttgart, Germany
papers.intro: 本文提出一种无需微调、无需生成架构的零样本方法，通过将现成的CLIP双编码器与集成雅可比（Integrated Jacobians）归因相结合，成功预测了视觉世界实验中的注视行为，并复现了经典研究中的人类预测性加工效应。

papers.title: WNM-3D: A World Navigation Model with 3D Scene Conditioning for Closed-Loop VLN
papers.authors: Yuehao Huang, Yunzi Wu, Xiaotao Zhang, Xinhai Li, Jiankun Dong, Jiajun Lv, Chi Zhang, Chenjia Bai, Yong Liu, Xuelong Li
papers.affiliations: Institute of Artificial Intelligence, China Telecom; Zhejiang University; Tongji University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: WNM-3D 提出一种基于3D场景条件的世界导航模型，通过将单目RGB历史编码为几何感知场景前缀，并以块因果注意力联合生成未来视图和导航动作，在连续VLN中实现了更优的闭环导航性能。

papers.title: InstanceSplat: Instance-Aware Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for Scene Understanding
papers.authors: Minchao Jiang, Xiaoxuan Ma, Shunyu Jia, Haoru Wang, Zhang Liang, Wentao Zhu
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo; Carnegie Mellon University; Xidian University; Peking University
papers.intro: 本文提出 InstanceSplat，一个统一的前馈式 3DGS 框架，从无位姿多视图图像中单次前向构建实例感知高斯表示，同时联合实现可泛化的新视角合成、实例分割和开放词汇语义理解。

papers.title: Human-AI Perceptual Alignment by Playing Hues and Cues
papers.authors: Nuria Alabau-Bosque, Jorge Vila-Tomás, Paula Daudén-Oliver, Pablo Hernández-Cámara, Valero Laparra, Jesús Malo
papers.affiliations: Image Processing Lab, Universitat de València
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于棋盘游戏Hues and Cues的离散色彩空间评估框架，将480个棋盘颜色映射至CIE xy色度图，通过325名人类观察者建立一致性基线并评估162个CVLM模型，揭示了模型在抽象概念上系统性地偏离人类基线并出现“默认蓝色”塌缩现象。

papers.title: Beyond Fluency: A Clinical Benchmark and Anomaly-Enhanced Baseline for Spine MRI Report Generation
papers.authors: Bruno Palau, Franziska Vogt, Daria Laslo, Haobo Li, Ender Konukoglu, Maria Monzon, Catherine R. Jutzeler
papers.affiliations: ETH Zurich（所有作者），Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics (SIB)（Maria Monzon, Catherine R. Jutzeler）
papers.intro: 论文针对腰椎MRI报告生成，指出现有语言指标无法反映诊断正确性，并提出一个架构无关的异常引导框架——利用半监督U-Net++生成椎间盘级异常热图作为辅助视觉输入，同时用于VLM报告生成和独立临床可解释性输出。
